spec.title: crok Harness
spec.description: What crok does between model calls: each turn is one trace whose root span (invoke_agent) holds its model calls and tool runs (execute_tool). Where a turn's time goes, which tools fail, how turns end, by origin (local, headless crok -p, relay from the web and phones). crok releases after 2.0.1; experiment runs (origin eval) are left out.

list.name: repo_re
list.label: Repo (regex)
list.description: Filter by repository, for example CharryLee0426/crok-build

panels.title: Turns
panels.description: Turns crok ran: one per prompt, plus the retries a completion requirement asks for. Grafana Cloud runs a TraceQL metrics query over 25 hours at most, so keep the time range at 24 hours or less.

panels.title: Completed
panels.description: Share of turns that ended with an answer (the SLO is 95%). The rest were cancelled, hit --max-turns, were stopped for repeating the same call, or failed. Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: p50 turn time
panels.description: Half the turns took less than this, from the prompt to the answer. Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: p90 turn time
panels.description: 90% of turns took less than this. Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: Model calls per turn
panels.description: Mean model calls a turn made. A weak model needs many more for the same task. Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: Tool runs per turn
panels.description: Mean tool runs a turn made. Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: Turns by outcome
panels.description: completed, cancelled (the user interrupted), max_turns, stationarity (the identical-call guard stopped a loop), error. Grafana Cloud runs a TraceQL metrics query over 25 hours at most, so keep the time range at 24 hours or less.

panels.title: Turns by origin
panels.description: local (the TUI and Crok Desktop), headless (crok -p), relay (a prompt from the web or a phone).

panels.title: Turns by model
panels.description: The model the turn started with.

panels.title: p90 turn time by model
panels.description: How long the slowest tenth of turns took, per model. Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: Model calls per turn by model
panels.description: Mean model calls per turn: the cost of a weak model is mostly time. Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: Turns by agent version
panels.description: crok's release and commit (2.0.2+1a2b3c4d).

panels.title: Tool runs by tool
panels.description: Every tool run, by tool.

panels.title: Failed tool runs by tool
panels.description: Tool runs that failed: a non-zero exit, a tool error, or a failure to start.

panels.title: p90 tool time by tool
panels.description: How long the slowest tenth of each tool's runs took. Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: Tool failure rate
panels.description: Share of tool runs that failed, over time.

panels.title: Tool runs by kind
panels.description: read_only, mutating (edits, shell commands), other (MCP, browser, phone).

panels.title: Backgrounded
panels.description: Commands crok moved to the background and polled later.

panels.title: Latest turns
panels.description: The newest turns. Open a trace to see the turn's model calls and tool runs in order.

panels.title: Turns that did not complete
panels.description: Cancelled, max_turns, stationarity and failed turns: where to look for regressions.

panels.title: Failed tool runs
panels.description: The error's first line is the span status; the full output is in the conversation in Agent Observability.
